app.name: PokeMMO Box
app.tagline: Tools for PokeMMO, built from the data the game exports.

watch.title: Watch species
watch.intro: Get a notification as soon as an alpha or a swarm of a watched species is reported. Works while a tab of the site stays open.

notif.on: Notifications are on while a tab of the site is open.
notif.denied: Your browser blocks notifications for this site: allow them in the site settings.

home.pokedex: All 649 Pokémon in PokeMMO: locations, hordes, abilities, moves. Search by any mix of moves and abilities.
home.collection: Import your game export and see all your Pokémon, IVs, EVs and natures. Showdown export in one click.
home.team: Build a team from your Pokémon: level 50 stats, weaknesses, offensive coverage.
home.breeding: How many parents, Braces and Everstones for a 5x31 with nature.
home.berries: Track your berry plots and know when to harvest.
home.cosmetics: All 772 cosmetics in the game. Tick the ones you have to see what you’re missing.
home.party: Your party, from your last import
home.partyEmpty: Import your game export to see your party here
home.swarms: Alphas and swarms reported live by players, with ability, moves and best Ball.
home.guides: Amulet Coin, 7 Hells, EVs, shinies and item farming, linked to your collection: see at once which Pokémon are ready.

seo.homeTitle: PokeMMO Box: tools and guides for PokeMMO
seo.home: PokeMMO Pokédex with locations and hordes, collection import, team builder, breeding simulator, guides (Amulet Coin, 7 Hells, EVs, shinies) and live alphas.

team.name: Team name

team.allCovered: Every type is hit super effectively.

breeding.title: Breeding simulator
breeding.intro: Each parent passes one IV with a Brace or the nature with an Everstone. IVs both parents share are passed automatically. The order you pick matters: the first IV picked is the one needing the most parents.
breeding.anyTarget: Pick it to search your boxes
breeding.fromBox: {have} steps already covered by your Pokémon, {missing} base parents left to find.
breeding.noneOwned: No compatible Pokémon (egg group) in your collection.

berries.title: Berry helper
berries.intro: Log your plots; the page works out when to harvest. Data stays in this browser.

cosmetics.title: Cosmetics
cosmetics.intro: Every cosmetic in the game, by slot. Tick the ones you own: the list stays in this browser.

swarms.title: Alphas and swarms
swarms.intro: Alphas and swarms reported live by players. Data: {source}. The page refreshes itself every minute.
swarms.error: Couldn’t reach the swarm server. Retrying in a minute.

none.alpha: No alpha right now. They show up in windows of a few hours.
none.swarm: No active swarm. They last about 15 minutes: check back soon.

guides.title: Guides
guides.intro: Step-by-step guides linked to your collection: each team slot shows your closest Pokémon and what it’s missing.

shiny.title: Shiny hunting
shiny.card: Encounter counter, odds with Shiny Charm and Donator status, and the best hordes for your target.
shiny.intro: Count your encounters while hunting: the site works out your chance of having met a shiny already and shows where your target appears in hordes.
shiny.median: Half of hunts end before {half} encounters, nine in ten before {ninety}.
shiny.chance: {p} chance you’ve already seen a shiny
shiny.noHorde: This Pokémon doesn’t appear in hordes.
shiny.source: Odds: 1/30,000 base, -10 % with Donator status, -10 % with your Shiny Charm. Sources: {wiki}, {pikammo}.

items.title: Item farming
items.card: Wild Pokémon that hold an item, and where to find them in hordes to steal it.
items.intro: Pick an item: see the wild Pokémon that can hold it and their best encounter spots, hordes first.
items.how: Frisk (Gothitelle, Gourgeist…) reveals which Pokémon of the horde holds an item; Thief, Covet or the Pickpocket ability takes it. The game export doesn’t give the hold rate.
items.more: and {n} more places on its Pokédex page

team.title: Team
team.noCollection: Import your collection to see which of your Pokémon fit.
team.how: For each slot, your Pokémon that meets the most requirements.

rune.title: Amulet Coin farming
rune.card: Steal Amulet Coins from the Meowth on Treasure Beach with Gothitelle and Weavile.
rune.intro: The Meowth on Treasure Beach sometimes hold an Amulet Coin. You steal it without fighting thanks to Pickpocket.
rune.whereText: Treasure Beach, south of One Island (Sevii Islands, Kanto): Fly to One Island, then head south of the Pokémon Center. Hordes of 5 Meowth Lv.38–39 in the grass.
rune.whenText: Night only (5 % of encounters), all year round, with Sweet Scent.
rune.lootText: Amulet Coin (the goal) and Quick Claw. Around 150,000 to 200,000 ¥/h according to a May 2026 guide, not guaranteed.
rune.note: Imprison only protects the first switch. If several Meowth hold an item, a second thief (Insomnia or Vital Spirit + Thief) helps.
rune.price: Selling price of an Amulet Coin (¥)
rune.source: Based on Eevelen’s “Farmeo Amuleto” guide. The counter stays in this browser.
rune.mapCaption: Sevii Islands: Treasure Beach is south of One Island.

hells.title: 7 Hells · Gyms
hells.card: The gym rematch route across 5 regions, gym by gym, with progress tracking and your team checked.
hells.intro: Prepare the team, then follow each gym in order, case by case. Your progress stays in this browser.
hells.teamIntro: Six level 100 Pokémon. 31 in Speed and Attack (or Sp. Atk); Aerodactyl and Excadrill also need at least 20 in their defensive IVs.
hells.searchUrgent: Search a Pokémon or a problem (e.g. Gyarados, rain)
hells.source: Based on the community route “Seven Hells · Lucky Girl Syndrome” and Eevelen’s adaptation. Route last revised: 10 June 2026.

evs.trackHelp: Click after each horde: the “Now” column updates. A new import that includes these EVs resets the tracking.
evs.trackNoMon: Pick a Pokémon to keep its tracking from one session to the next.
evs.title: EV training
evs.card: How many hordes your Pokémon still needs, and the best hordes by stat, region and season, from the game data.
evs.intro: Pick a Pokémon from your collection and the target spread: the page counts the hordes left and lists the best hordes for each stat, from the game data.
evs.caps: {cap} EVs max per stat, {total} in total.
evs.braceText: It doubles the EVs from every Pokémon defeated: a horde of 5 Pokémon giving 2 EVs yields 20 instead of 10.
evs.howText: Sweet Scent starts a horde; knock it out with a spread move. The Pokémon in training must take part in the battle (lead, or hold an Exp. Share).
evs.berriesN: {n} {berry} Berry to remove the excess | {n} {berry} Berries to remove the excess
evs.tooMany: That’s over the maximum: lower a stat.
evs.forYou: ≈ {n} horde for your goal | ≈ {n} hordes for your goal
evs.berriesText: Each berry removes 10 EVs from its stat.
evs.source: Hordes, places, seasons and rates come from the game export. Method based on Eevelen’s “EV training 2026” guide. Your choices stay in this browser.
evs.notPlaced: This place isn’t on the map yet.
